offering_description.value: Promotes, produces and hosts concerts and live events, and sells tickets to fans through its own ticketing platform. Serves artists, fans, venues and sponsors, earning fees from ticket sales, sponsorship deals and artist services, and operating owned venues.

primary_services.value: concert promotion; venue operations; ticketing services; sponsorship and advertising; artist management

customer_segment.value: B2C: concertgoers and sports and live event fans buying tickets; B2B: music artists, sports teams, venue owners and brand sponsors

end_markets.value: live music; sports; comedy and theater; sponsorship and advertising

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: ticket sales and per-ticket fees paid by fans; project or contract: promoting and producing concerts for artists and venues; advertising: sponsorship and advertising deals paid by brands; commissions or management fees: artist management commissions
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; project or contract; advertising; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: promotes and stages events for artists and venue owners, earning fees from them; software / platform: ticketing platform sold to fans, venues and event organizers; asset operator: owns and operates concert venues and amphitheaters, renting them to promoters and artists
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: concert promotion, venues, ticketing and sponsorship sharing the same fans and artists

distribution_channels.value: online: ticket sales through its website and mobile app; own locations: owned and operated concert venues and amphitheaters; direct sales: sponsorship and advertising sold directly to brands; partners / resellers: third-party ticket resellers and venue partners
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer protection rules on ticket fees, data privacy, antitrust scrutiny, and venue safety and licensing rules
